info.description: Evidence-grounded agricultural drought adaptation decision support. Indicators describe rainfall, temperature, and soil moisture relative to reference periods; they do not measure drought impact or classify severity.
info.title: ClimateAdapt Lab API

post.description: Compares the observed calendar-month window total with the mean of the same window over the baseline years, at the CHIRPS grid cell containing the point. The first request for a period reads many monthly values and may be slow; later requests use the local cache. Not a drought-severity classification.
post.summary: Precipitation percentage anomaly computed from CHIRPS v3 Final

post.description: SPI for the window ending at target_end_month, calibrated on the reference period (gamma distribution per calendar month; WMO-No. 1090). Precipitation only: it does not measure agricultural drought impact and no severity labels are returned. A cold request reads about timescale x reference-years monthly values and may take a minute or more.
post.summary: Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) from CHIRPS v3 Final

post.description: Queues one bundle run over CHIRPS SPI, ERA5-Land SPI, temperature anomaly and soil-moisture anomaly (layer 1) and returns 202 + job id immediately; poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} for the result. Each indicator reports its own status (ok / undefined / failed / skipped) with result or error type, provenance, limitations, and coordinates. Failures are never hidden, never merged into a composite score, and never labelled by severity.
post.summary: Per-indicator environmental bundle: CHIRPS SPI + ERA5 trio (job)

post.description: Queues an ERA5-Land soil-moisture-anomaly computation (layers 1-3) and returns 202 + job id immediately; poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} for the result. Values in m3/m3 with standardized anomaly; anomalies only, no category labels. Cold CDS requests take minutes.
post.summary: Soil-moisture window anomaly from ERA5-Land (background job)

post.description: Queues an ERA5-Land SPI computation and returns 202 + job id immediately; poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} for the result. Gamma fit per calendar month (WMO-No. 1090); no severity labels. Cold CDS requests take minutes.
post.summary: Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) from ERA5-Land (background job)

post.description: Queues an ERA5-Land temperature-anomaly computation and returns 202 + job id immediately; poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} for the result. Day-weighted window means in degC with standardized anomaly and percentile rank. Cold CDS requests take minutes.
post.summary: Temperature window anomaly from ERA5-Land (background job)
Prototype precipitation percentage anomaly from user-supplied totals

get.description: Catalogue of captured scenario runs served verbatim for demos. Needs CLIMATEADAPT_DEMO_MODE=true; otherwise 404 (demo_mode_disabled). Snapshots live under a git-ignored directory; see scripts/capture_demo_snapshot.py.
get.summary: List stored real-data demo snapshots (demo mode only)

get.description: Returns the captured detail verbatim. Clients must label it a cached real-data snapshot with the capture timestamp, never a live result. Unknown keys return 404 (demo_snapshot_not_found).
get.summary: Fetch one stored demo snapshot by key (demo mode only)

get.description: Returns the job snapshot: queued / running / succeeded / failed / timed_out, step progress, and the result or typed error once terminal. Unknown or TTL-expired ids return 404 (job_not_found).
get.summary: Poll a background job for status, progress, result, or error

post.description: Validates the scenario, persists it, queues one bounded agent run (bundle, retrieval, ranking, draft, validate), and returns 202 with the scenario and job ids. Poll GET /v1/scenarios/{id} for the stored bundle, ranking, report, and trace. No authentication in this demo API. A full job store returns 503 (server_busy).
post.summary: Create a scenario: run the agent pipeline as a background job

delete.description: Removes the scenario row; a still-running worker discards its result. Unknown ids return 404 (scenario_not_found).
delete.summary: Delete a stored scenario (a running job is left to finish unseen)

get.description: While the run is queued/running, outputs are null. Terminal runs carry the deterministic bundle and ranking plus either the validated report (complete) or the labelled fallback (partial), with problems and warnings explaining why. Unknown ids return 404 (scenario_not_found).
get.summary: Retrieve one scenario with bundle, ranking, report, and trace
